units.source_text: 那时，我专心致志地盯着荡漾的海水，

en.t: At that time, I was staring intently at the rippling seawater,

units.source_text: 水中游动着一群群略呈紫色的鲷鱼，别有情趣，令人百看不厌。

en.t: where schools of slightly purplish sea bream were swimming, a charming sight I could watch without ever tiring of it.

units.source_text: 然而，K似乎并没有我那样高的兴致，

en.t: However, K did not seem to be as deeply interested as I was,

units.source_text: 比起观看鲷鱼，他似乎更关心日莲。

en.t: and rather than watching the sea bream, he seemed more concerned with Nichiren.

units.source_text: 正好不远处有个叫诞生寺的寺院，

en.t: As it happened, there was a temple called Tanjoji not far away,

units.source_text: 多半是因为日莲诞生在这地方，才叫诞生寺的吧。

en.t: probably named so because Nichiren had been born in that place.

units.source_text: 那是一座很漂亮的寺院，K提议到寺院去拜访住持。

en.t: It was a very fine temple, and K suggested that we go there and visit the head priest.

units.source_text: 说实在的，我们俩的穿着太不像样了。

en.t: To tell the truth, the two of us were dressed in a terrible state.

units.source_text: 尤其是K，他的帽子被风刮到海里了，

en.t: K in particular had had his hat blown into the sea by the wind,

units.source_text: 只好买了一顶斗笠戴在头上。

en.t: so he had been forced to buy a bamboo hat and wear it on his head.

units.source_text: 我们的衣服本来就很脏，还散发着汗酸味。

en.t: Our clothes were filthy to begin with, and they also gave off the sour smell of sweat.

units.source_text: 我劝他别去见和尚了，

en.t: I urged him not to go and meet the monk,

units.source_text: 但他很固执，不听我的，

en.t: but he was stubborn and would not listen to me,

units.source_text: 还说你要不愿意去，就在外边等着好了。

en.t: and he said that if I did not want to go, I could simply wait outside.

units.source_text: 我只得跟他一起进了山门，

en.t: I had no choice but to enter the temple gate with him,

units.source_text: 心想一定会被人家拒绝的。

en.t: thinking to myself that we would certainly be turned away.

units.source_text: 谁知和尚却很客气，

en.t: Unexpectedly, however, the monk was very courteous,

units.source_text: 把我们让进了宽敞漂亮的客厅，住持马上会见了我们。

en.t: showed us into a spacious and elegant reception room, and the head priest met with us at once.

units.source_text: 那时，我的想法跟K相去甚远，

en.t: At that time, my way of thinking was very different from K's,

units.source_text: 所以没有心思听他和住持谈话。

en.t: so I had little inclination to listen to his conversation with the head priest.

units.source_text: 记得他一个劲儿地询问关于日莲的事迹，

en.t: I remember that he kept asking questions about Nichiren's deeds,

units.source_text: 我还记得，当住持说到日莲被称为草日莲，是因为日莲写得一手漂亮的草书的时候，

en.t: and I also remember that when the head priest said Nichiren was called Grass-Style Nichiren because he wrote beautiful cursive calligraphy,

units.source_text: 毛笔字很差劲的K，露出不以为然的表情。

en.t: K, whose brush calligraphy was very poor, showed an unimpressed expression.

units.source_text: 也许他是想了解比毛笔字之类的事更有意义的日莲吧。

en.t: Perhaps he wanted to understand a Nichiren more meaningful than matters such as brush calligraphy.

units.source_text: 在这一点上，住持是否使他感到满足，我说不好，

en.t: I cannot say whether the head priest satisfied him on that point,

units.source_text: 不过，一出寺院，他就跟我滔滔不绝地讲起了日莲。

en.t: but as soon as we left the temple, he began speaking to me about Nichiren at great length.

units.source_text: 我又热又累，哪有心情听他讲这些，

en.t: I was hot and tired, and in no mood to listen to him talk about such things,

units.source_text: 只是随口附和着，

en.t: so I merely gave him casual replies,

units.source_text: 后来连应也懒得应，干脆不作声了。

en.t: and later, too weary even to respond, I simply fell silent.
